title: A Spot of Bother
question: What did the old lady find when she got home?

meanings.usage: 常用a spot of bother表示小麻烦
常用于口语中表示打扰某人
英式英语中常用，美式英语用apartment
正式用词，指严厉地批评或责备
指由于不注意而造成的错误或疏忽
形容做事深思熟虑、小心谨慎
指在困难情况下保持冷静的能力
指隐藏在暗处等待时机
指手指留下的纹路，用于身份识别

meanings.meaning: 难以置信的；不可思议的
meanings.usage: 指某事令人难以想象或相信
原指喜鹊，因其收集习惯比喻爱收集东西的人
指储藏钱或物品以备将来使用
指为寻找东西而翻遍某处
珠宝的总称，不可数名词
指打断某人的活动或使某人担忧
形容人对小事过分担心或挑剔

phrases.usage: 表示小麻烦、小纠纷，是英语中常用的委婉表达

examples.en: She described it as a little spot of bother.
examples.zh: 她把这描述为一点小麻烦。

phrases.usage: 指通过武力或强行手段进入某处

examples.en: Burglars had forced an entry during her absence.
examples.zh: 窃贼趁她不在时强行闯入了。

phrases.usage: 表示在某人这个年纪，常用于表达某种行为是否适合某人的年龄

examples.en: At her age, it might be more prudent to have someone with her.
examples.zh: 在她这个年纪，有人陪着可能更明智。

phrases.usage: 指把东西翻过来或翻遍

examples.en: Everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over.
examples.zh: 她的所有东西都被扔了出来，翻了个遍。

examples.en: She regained her composure and was ready to search.
examples.zh: 她恢复了镇定，准备开始搜查。

phrases.usage: 表示不是第一次做某事，暗示之前有过类似经历

examples.en: Their entry into this flat was apparently not the burglars' first job that day.
examples.zh: 他们进入这间公寓显然不是当天第一次作案。

phrases.usage: 指打电话，是口语中常见的表达

examples.en: She rang up her daughter and asked for help.
examples.zh: 她给女儿打电话请求帮助。

examples.en: The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats.
examples.zh: 老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓。

examples.en: Her basket had grown heavier with every step.
examples.zh: 她的篮子每走一步就重一些。

phrases.usage: 比喻某事非常清楚、显而易见

examples.en: It was as clear as daylight that burglars had forced an entry.
examples.zh: 显而易见，窃贼强行闯入了。

sentences.en: The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats where she lived.
sentences.zh: 老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓楼。

sentences.en: Her shopping had tired her and her basket had grown heavier with every step of the way home.
sentences.zh: 购物让她感到疲惫，回家的每一步都让她手里的篮子变得更沉。

sentences.en: In the lift her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest;
sentences.zh: 在电梯里，她想着午餐和好好休息；

sentences.en: but when she got out at her own floor, both were forgotten in her sudden discovery that her front door was open.
sentences.zh: 但当她走出电梯到达自己的楼层时，她突然发现前门开着，午餐和休息都被抛到了脑后。

sentences.en: She was thinking that she must reprimand her home help the next morning for such a monstrous piece of negligence,
sentences.zh: 她心想，明天早上一定要训斥她的家政人员，因为她如此严重的疏忽，

sentences.en: when she remembered that she had gone shopping after the home help had left and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks.
sentences.zh: 但她随即想起，家政人员离开后她才去购物，而且她确定自己把两把钥匙都锁好了。

sentences.en: She walked slowly into the hall and at once noticed that all the room doors were open,
sentences.zh: 她慢慢地走进门厅，立刻注意到所有的房门都开着，

sentences.en: yet following her regular practice she had shut them before going out.
sentences.zh: 然而按照她的习惯，出门前她都会关好门。

sentences.en: Looking into the drawing room, she saw a scene of confusion over by her writing desk.
sentences.zh: 往客厅里一看，她看到写字台附近一片混乱。

sentences.en: It was as clear as daylight then that burglars had forced an entry during her absence.
sentences.zh: 这时，她才明白，在她外出期间，窃贼破门而入了，这简直是明摆着的事。

sentences.en: Her first impulse was to go round all the rooms looking for the thieves,
sentences.zh: 她最初的冲动是把所有房间都找一遍，看看有没有小偷，

sentences.en: but then she decided that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her,
sentences.zh: 但后来她觉得，以她的年纪，找个人陪着会更稳妥，

sentences.en: so she went to fetch the porter from his basement.
sentences.zh: 于是她下楼去地下室找看门人。

sentences.en: By this time her legs were beginning to tremble, so she sat down and accepted a cup of very strong tea, while he telephoned the police.
sentences.zh: 这时她的双腿开始颤抖，于是她坐下来，喝了一杯很浓的茶，看门人则打电话报了警。

sentences.en: Then, her composure regained, she was ready to set off with the porter's assistance to search for any intruders who might still be lurking in her flat.
sentences.zh: 恢复镇定后，她在看门人的协助下准备出发，搜寻可能仍藏在她公寓里的不速之客。

sentences.en: They went through the rooms, being careful to touch nothing,
sentences.zh: 他们检查了各个房间，小心翼翼地不碰任何东西，

sentences.en: as they did not want to hinder the police in their search for fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不想妨碍警方寻找指纹。

sentences.en: The chaos was inconceivable.
sentences.zh: 现场一片狼藉，简直难以置信。

sentences.en: She had lived in the flat for thirty years and was a veritable magpie at hoarding:
sentences.zh: 她在这间公寓住了三十年，是个名副其实的“喜鹊”，喜欢囤积物品：

sentences.en: and it seemed as though everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over and over.
sentences.zh: 似乎她所有的东西都被翻了出来，翻了个底朝天。

sentences.en: At least sorting out the things she should have discarded years ago was now being made easier for her.
sentences.zh: 至少，现在整理那些她几年前就该扔掉的东西变得容易多了。

sentences.en: Then a police inspector arrived with a constable and she told them of her discovery of the ransacked flat.
sentences.zh: 随后，一名警督带着一名警员赶到，她向他们讲述了她发现公寓被洗劫一空的情况。

sentences.en: The inspector began to look for fingerprints, while the constable checked that the front door locks had not been forced,
sentences.zh: 警督开始寻找指纹，而警员则检查前门锁是否没有被撬，

sentences.en: thereby proving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony.
sentences.zh: 这证明窃贼要么使用了万能钥匙，要么是从阳台进入的。

sentences.en: There was no trace of fingerprints, but the inspector found a dirty red bundle that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers.
sentences.zh: 没有指纹痕迹，但警督发现了一个脏兮兮的红色包裹，里面装着珠宝，老太太说那不是她的。

sentences.en: So their entry into this flat was apparently not the burglars' first job that day and they must have been disturbed.
sentences.zh: 所以他们闯入这间公寓显然不是窃贼当天做的第一起案子，而且他们一定是在作案时受到了惊扰。

sentences.en: The inspector then asked the old lady to try to check what was missing by the next day,
sentences.zh: 警督随后要求老太太在第二天之前尽量清点一下丢失的物品，

sentences.en: and advised her not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights.
sentences.zh: 并建议她几晚不要独自待在公寓里。

sentences.en: The old lady thought he was a fussy creature,
sentences.zh: 老太太觉得他是个爱挑剔的人，

sentences.en: but since the porter agreed with him, she rang up her daughter and asked for her help in what she described as a little spot of bother.
sentences.zh: 但看门人也同意他的看法，于是她打电话给女儿，请她帮忙解决她所说的“一点小麻烦”。

options: even though/even if引导的让步状语从句
一般现在时表客观事实和普遍规律
exercises.explain: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)：had + 过去分词：当需要表达'过去的过去'这一概念时使用，常与when, after, before等连用，或用于宾语从句中

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，常用于描述过去的背景或先发生的事件
grammar.usage: 当需要表达'过去的过去'这一概念时使用，常与when, after, before等连用，或用于宾语从句中

examples.en: She had gone shopping after the home help had left.
examples.zh: 她在管家离开后才去购物。

examples.en: She had shut them before going out.
examples.zh: 她在出门前把门都关上了。

examples.en: The burglars must have been disturbed.
examples.zh: 窃贼一定是被打扰了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，或用来描述过去的背景
grammar.usage: 常用于描述故事发生的背景，或与when/while等连用表示两个同时进行的动作

examples.en: Her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest.
examples.zh: 她满脑子想的都是午餐和好好休息。

examples.en: She was thinking that she must reprimand her home help.
examples.zh: 她正想着第二天早上一定要责备她的管家。

grammar.title: must have + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示对过去发生的事情的推测，意为'一定/肯定做过某事'
grammar.usage: 用于根据现有证据或情况对过去事件进行肯定性的推测

examples.en: They must have been disturbed.
examples.zh: 他们一定是被打扰了。

examples.en: She must reprimand her home help.
examples.zh: 她必须责备她的管家。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be glad to + 动词原形

original.en: The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats.
original.zh: 老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓。

examples.en: I was glad to see my old friends again.
examples.zh: 我很高兴再次见到我的老朋友们。

examples.en: She was glad to finish her work on time.
examples.zh: 她很高兴按时完成了工作。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be/feel + 形容词 + to + 动词原形

original.en: At her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her.
original.zh: 在她这个年纪，有人陪着可能更明智。

examples.en: It might be better to wait for the police.
examples.zh: 等待警察可能更好。

examples.en: It is wise to check everything carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细检查一切是明智的。

original.en: It was as clear as daylight that burglars had forced an entry.
original.zh: 显而易见，窃贼强行闯入了。

examples.en: It is obvious that she has been robbed.
examples.zh: 很明显她被抢劫了。

examples.en: It is certain that he will come tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他明天一定会来。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + before + doing something

original.en: She had shut them before going out.
original.zh: 她在出门前把门都关上了。

examples.en: He had finished his homework before watching TV.
examples.zh: 他在看电视前已经完成了作业。

examples.en: I had locked the door before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前已经锁好了门。
